# dsh-tool-budget
DeepSeek Harness plugin: **hard-stop** tool use after a **per-session** call budget.
Pairs with dsh-repeat-stop. Part of **dsh-wsl-kit**.
中文说明 → README.zh.md
## Where it sits
Hard-stops tool use after a per-session budget. Identical-call loops are dsh-repeat-stop.

## Why
Repeat-stop catches identical spam. Budget catches “many different tools forever” in one session—use
ful when long WSL tasks burn API quota.
